mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 79 degrees over at Fireman's Park. The moon is currently in a Waning Gibbous phase.

September 2026 is officially Hunger Action Month in Verona to fight food insecurity across Dane County. Additionally, please prepare for traffic delays on Highway M this Monday and Tuesday due to road construction for utility work.

There is plenty to do this weekend with the Verona Area Kids Triathlon, Girls Try Hockey at the Ice Arena, and live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, all happening today. Looking ahead, you can join the fun at the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on September 2nd.

In a report regarding activity between August 17th and August 24th, on August 19th officers responded to a motor vehicle crash on North Main Street where minor injuries were reported and citations were issued.
Culver's is currently open until 10 PM today, serving up the delicious Crazy for Cookie Dough flavor of the day.
